name: stackd
description: Stackd — upload a retail receipt, get real tokenized equity back.
//engines: Railway's builder (Railpack) keeps only the major version of a range, so ">=18.17" ran the API on Node 18. Pinned to a major instead: the API's DKIM check (mailauth) needs Node 22.19 or later, and Vercel reads the same field.
//react: @solana/wallet-adapter-react depends on @solana-mobile/wallet-adapter-mobile, which drags in react-native and its own exact react peer. npm can hoist that copy to the root, and a react and react-dom of different versions break the build before a page renders. Declaring react and react-dom here, with matching overrides, keeps exactly one hoisted copy of each at the same version.
//devDependencies: npm hoists everything except `next` (its platform-specific @next/swc optional deps keep it nested in apps/web). eslint-config-next gets hoisted to the root and then cannot resolve next/dist/compiled/babel/eslint-parser, so `next lint` dies. Declaring next here too puts one copy at the root where both resolve.
